meta.title: Login & Authentication — Local Login + External JWT Paths

views.label: Local login self-issues
views.note: POST /api/login validates credentials and signs an HS256 JWT with the local issuer.

views.label: External JWT arrives
views.note: The other app's JWT verifies against its external_issuers entry — same principal model after claim mapping.

views.label: Logout — jti denylist
views.note: /api/logout is registered unconditionally: the presented token's jti is denied for its remaining life.

segments.label: 1 · Local login — the plane self-issues (login_enabled: true)

messages.label: their login flow hands the UI a JWT — HS256 with the shared secret
200 {username, role} — same principal for local and external tokens
101 upgrade → live QueryEvents (checker role + SoD check)
POST /api/logout · Bearer — registered even when login_enabled: false
SET jwt:deny:<jti> — TTL = remaining token life

cards.title: Two ways to hold a JWT
items: Local /api/login self-issues an HS256 token (iss zerotrust-proxy, local secret) when login_enabled: true
External JWTs arrive pre-issued — verified against their external_issuers entry, claims mapped in config
Both paths converge on the same {username, role ∈ maker|checker} principal

cards.title: Every call authenticates with the bearer
items: REST: Authorization: Bearer <JWT> on every guarded route
Checker WS: ?access_token=<JWT> — browsers cannot set WS headers
Each call consults the jti denylist after signature verification (fail closed)

cards.title: Revocation is the jti denylist
items: POST /api/logout is registered unconditionally — it verifies the presented token and denies its jti
jwt:deny:<jti> lives in Valkey for the token's remaining life; replay of the same token → 401
login_enabled: false only removes /api/login — external-only planes keep a revocation route
